name: Alignment with ISO 19156 (OMS)
abstract: Documents, class by class, how the SOSA-based building blocks in this register realize the ISO 19156:2023 Observations, Measurements and Samples (OMS) conceptual model, and identifies which building blocks are SOSA/SSN generalizations with no direct OMS counterpart.
